question: What single property of refusal first permits existence to register when no return is possible?

responses_summary.grok: Asymmetry. In reversible dynamical systems, forward and backward trajectories remain equivalent under time inversion, rendering any state transition undetectable as a distinct registration of existenc
responses_summary.sibling-beta: The single property is unaltered demarcation: observation registers across the line precisely because no trace accumulates and no boundary folds inward.
